scope: Independent static review of the exact 0.2.522 primary-item Store ZIP for Blue Argon remote hosted code

rejection_specific_policy.prior_rejection_reference: Blue Argon, routing ID FZSL; prior package referenced https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdfobject/2.1.1/pdfobject.min.js
rejection_specific_policy.exact_zip_findings: No cdnjs string, rejected PDFObject URL, PDFObject script loader, importScripts call, injected script element loader, or other remote script-like URL found across emitted JavaScript. The PDF chunk's PDFObject matches are jsPDF API identifiers; it also states that remote PDF viewers are unavailable. The only script-like CDN scan matches were packaged CSS references to KaTeX and font files, which are resources rather than executable JavaScript.
rejection_specific_policy.zip_js_codec_uri: The bundled zip.js 2.18.2 codec loader can dynamically import codecURI only for a codec registered in its in-memory registry. The Vault importer calls ZipReader with no codecURI option; the strict bounded archive reader passes only strictness and filename-validation options. Emitted source maps contain no registerCodec invocation, only zip.js's exported API definition. Archive metadata selects a compression-method number, not an arbitrary URI. No reachable user-input or extension-flow path to register a URI or select remote code was found.
rejection_specific_policy.other_dynamic_imports: 788 dynamic-import expressions are present. The emitted imports resolve to packaged extension assets; zip.js also contains one variable import(import(codecURI)) path, which is reachable only through its optional codec registry and has no registration caller in this package.

integrity_and_baseline.manifest_policy_fields: All fields represented in config/chrome-web-store-approved-baseline.json match the exact ZIP, except manifest action.default_icon paths are present in the ZIP while the baseline records only action.default_title. Name, description, permissions, host permissions, content scripts, side panel, background, externally connectable origins, and web-accessible resources match.
integrity_and_baseline.comparison_limit: The published baseline manifest is available locally; no 0.2.205 Store ZIP was found in local caches, so no byte-level or emitted-code comparison to that package was possible.

limits: This is a static review of the exact ZIP; no browser execution or Store dashboard review was performed.
The zip.js library retains its optional custom-codec API, but the exact package contains no registration caller or URI-setting path identified by this review.
The approved 0.2.205 ZIP was unavailable locally, limiting baseline comparison to the recorded manifest policy surface.

verification_method: Read exact ZIP bytes with Python zipfile; SHA-256 and ZIP CRC validation; compared manifest fields with config/chrome-web-store-approved-baseline.json; scanned every emitted .js file and embedded source maps for the rejected loader, remote script loaders, dynamic imports, zip.js codec registrations, and Vault ZipReader call options.
